title: Macro burger detail

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study

slide_intent: Make material details visible so a viewer can imagine freshness, texture and taste.
strategic_value: A close cross-section can focus Burger King’s identity on food ingredients rather than abstract claims.
demonstration: The frame crops tightly into bun, lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, sauce and grilled patty with no headline.
practical_value: Evaluate which ingredient details remain readable in a very tight food crop.

content_islands.name: Layered ingredients
content_islands.spec: Fill the upper and middle frame with bun and vegetables.

content_islands.name: Grilled texture
content_islands.spec: Retain the patty and sauce across the lower area to contrast textures.

reference_purposes.Expression: The macro photograph makes stacked ingredients and surface textures the entire composition.
